The Saltmarsh Courier has reported on the harbour, the marshes and the villages around them since the first edition was set by hand and carried round on a bicycle. It is written by the people who live here, for the people who live here, and it is paid for by its readers, which is why there has never been an advertisement on the front page and why there never will be one for as long as the present editor has anything to say about it.
